candidates.counter_evidence_explanation: Metrics show /v1/checkout 200s and no dependency-operation series, so the 500s are not fully reflected in aggregated metrics.
missing_evidence: Order service logs/traces showing the internal cause of its 500 responses
Order service error-rate and latency metrics for the incident window
candidates.statement: Order service returns HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders, which the gateway surfaces as 502 on POST /v1/checkout. Traces and logs show the gateway's client call to order:8000 failing with 500 Internal Server Error, propagating to checkout 502s.
candidates.uncertainty: Root cause within the order service (e.g. db-pool-exhaustion, bad-configuration) is not established by gateway-side evidence alone.

report.explanation: Gateway checkout 502s are explained by downstream order service 500s seen in traces and logs. The specific fault inside the order service is not yet evidenced, so the candidate is bounded to the observed HTTP 500 propagation.
